title: ID0368665 - DC/Si-D/EE- [MP / P0 170001064] - No SCB connection
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
No SCB connection
Root cause:
Router issue
Solution:
Site visit 12.7.2024
.
No ethernet connection to router. After power cycle, ethernet connection was restored. “No sim card inserted” and wrong APN. APN changed from "emobility.siemens" to "cu.siemens.global" and LTE forced ON. Connection to SCB restored.
